final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT z.city, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN zip_code AS z ON z.zip_code = m.zip GROUP BY z.city), city_shares AS (SELECT city, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM city_counts), ranked AS (SELECT member_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM city_shares) SELECT AVG(member_count) AS average_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM ranked WHERE share > average_share
